description: Source code for thread-local counters and global counter aggregation in the trace2 subsystem of Git.

methods.name: tr2_counter_increment
methods.description: Increments a specific counter by a given value, updating thread-local context flags.

methods.name: tr2_update_final_counters
methods.description: Aggregates thread-local counters into a final global counter block, assuming mutex lock is held.

methods.name: tr2_emit_per_thread_counters
methods.description: Emits per-thread counters that are marked for per-thread events if used.

methods.name: tr2_emit_final_counters
methods.description: Emits final counters from the global counter block if they have non-zero values.
